summary: Moab is condemned, and her people will sorrow—The Messiah will sit on David’s throne, seeking justice and hastening righteousness.
meta_description: Moab is condemned, and her people will sorrow—The Messiah will sit on David’s throne, seeking justice and hastening righteousness.

footnotes.note1_a: IE Send an appeal to the king of Judah, who then ruled also Edom.
footnotes.note3_a: HEB Give counsel. This begins Moab’s appeal to Judah (vv. 3–5).
footnotes.note4_a: HEB Let mine outcasts dwell with thee; be thou a covert for Moab.
footnotes.note6_a: Beginning of Judah’s reply, declining Moab’s appeal.
